data.text: Builders on Windows can run every wf step from BUILDER-PROMPT.md as written (t407u: wf resolves to Windows Fax, wf.exe works).

Goal: BUILDER-PROMPT.md tells the builder to run wf.exe, not wf, at every step (PowerShell resolves wf to Windows Fax, t407u; wf.exe also works in Git Bash).
Done when: every wf command line in a printed BUILDER-PROMPT.md starts with wf.exe, and cargo test --test wf builder_prompt passes on the box.

First real job over GitHub (t400u-t402u). Small on purpose: one template, one test. Start from wf-functional because only it has BUILDER-PROMPT (3daaa48). tests/wf.rs does not compile on Windows yet (unix-only imports): the builder runs cargo build there, the checker runs the test on the box.

fields.w02: in tests/wf.rs, update t401u_pack_on_the_shared_branch_prints_one_builder_prompt to expect "wf.exe claim 1.2.3.4 01" and "wf.exe return 1.2.3.4 01"
